claims.head: Calgary should get plenty of shots away
claims.body: Seattle is 30th of 32 at shot suppression, and Calgary is one of the league’s busiest shooting teams (5th: 62.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5).

check.measure: 5-on-5 shot attempts per 60, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Seattle pounces on mistakes, and Calgary makes them
claims.body: Seattle ranks 10th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.5% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Calgary ranks 30th for avoiding breakdowns.

SEA.head: Seattle has a slight edge
SEA.body: Seattle has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Not by much, though: Calgary can make it interesting if it keeps the shots coming.

CGY.head: A slightly uphill night for Calgary
CGY.body: Seattle has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Calgary can tip it if it keeps the shots coming.
